prompt: Build a pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using x402

spec.name: JokePayPerCall
spec.description: A pay-per-call joke API service that charges 0.005 USDC per request using the x402 protocol on Algorand

global_state.name: price_per_call
global_state.description: Price per call in microUSDC (5000 for 0.005 USDC)

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initialize the joke service with pricing

methods.name: record_payment
methods.description: Logs a verified payment from the x402 facilitator

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns the total number of jokes served

ui_requirements: Button to 'Get Joke' which triggers x402 payment flow
Dashboard showing total jokes served and total earnings
business_logic: Only the owner can withdraw funds
Price is defined in micro-units (6 decimals for USDC)
The record_payment method is called by the x402 middleware to sync on-chain state
